page_title: INT 1-2 SAS | Inter v Sassuolo 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+2' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

90+2' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the left post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.

90+1' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Massimi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the top right corner, but Yann Sommer pulls off a brilliant save.
87' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is adjudged offside.
85' It is time for a substitution. Davy Klaassen (Inter) is on for Hakan Calhanoglu.
85' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
81' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Martin Erlic is replaced by Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo).
79' The substitution is prepared. Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
74' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
73' Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
71' Simone Inzaghi (Inter) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) replaces Alessandro Bastoni.
68' Substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) on for Federico Dimarco.
68' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Henrikh Mkhitaryan and he is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
68' Substitution. Marcus Thuram did his best and is replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
66' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a foul and Luca Massimi immediately signals a free kick.

63' 1 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
61' Here is a change. Mattia Viti is going off and Alessio Dionisi gives the last tactical orders to Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo).
61' The substitution has been made. Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) has replaced Nedim Bajrami.
59' The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
58' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
54' 1 - 1 Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
52' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is first to the cross from Domenico Berardi, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
52' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
51' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Inter will take a corner kick.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matias Vina.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Luca Massimi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' None of the Sassuolo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45+4' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer answers with a superb save to deny him.
42' Nicolo Barella (Inter) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
41' One of the players from Inter times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
39' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.

39' A sweet pass finds Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Yann Sommer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
37' The ball is cleared after Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Inter earn a corner.
34' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
33' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Marcus Thuram (Inter) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
32' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

31' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
29' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
28' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Sassuolo keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
25' Flag up against Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Sassuolo get a corner.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
18' Nicolo Barella (Inter) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
14' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
12' Inter spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
9' Sassuolo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will deliver the corner kick.
1' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) comes to nothing.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Massimi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
